FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 354
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Mack Butler
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/23/2023
House Bill 354 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the local boards
of education to: 1) provide information to parents regarding health care services offered at a
local school and (2) adopt rules and notify parents of the procedures regarding resolving certain
parental concerns, as provided in this bill.
Additionally, this bill could increase the obligations of local school districts by an undetermined
amount dependent on the cost of a special magistrate appointed by the State Superintendent of
Education to resolve issues pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
